newsitem.title: USA: Insilco gets 2.6 mln shrs in self-tender.
newsitem.headline: Insilco gets 2.6 mln shrs in self-tender.

text.p: Insilco Corp said Tuesday that it had received about 2,610,000 shares for tender, under its previously announced offer to purchase up to 2,857,142 shares of its common stock at $38.50 per share.
The results were as of 5:00 p.m., New York City time on August 11, the company said.
The offer, launched July 11, will expire on August 12 at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, the company added.

Insilco Corp makes industrial components and supplies specialty publications. The company serves the automotive, electronics, telecommunications and other industrial markets, and its publishing business principally serves the school yearbook market.
